title: StoredColumnsUnusedReason
description: If the stored column was not used, explain why.

message.description: Specifies the detailed description for the scenario.

uncoveredColumns.description: Specifies which columns were not covered by the stored columns for the specified code up to 20 columns. This is populated when the code is STORED_COLUMNS_COVER_INSUFFICIENT and BASE_TABLE_HAS_CLS.

code.description: Specifies the high-level reason for the unused scenario, each reason must have a code associated.
